name: Balance Scale
creator: Jean-Francois.Bonin
attribution: Balance Scale by Jean-Francois.Bonin, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
modifications: Attempted mesh simplification to 0.45 ratio with 0.001 error threshold; the error threshold limited reduction to preserve the shape.
Quantized and compressed geometry with EXT_meshopt_compression.
educationalRole: A concrete balance-scale object for the weighing instrument lesson; the lesson text distinguishes older two-pan balance scales from modern digital scales.
limitations: The source describes the object as a legal scale, so it is used only as a visual balance-scale example, not as a certified instrument or a claim about a specific local market scale.
